signature.name: VTask.RestrictGermPredicate
signature.type: {X : Type u_1} -> {Y : Type u_2} -> [TopologicalSpace X] -> (P : (x : X) → (nhds x).Germ Y → Prop) -> (A : Set X) -> (x : X) -> (nhds x).Germ Y → Prop

conventions.statement: When x does not belong to A, VTask.RestrictGermPredicate P A x φ holds vacuously for every germ φ, because the condition x ∈ A is required as a hypothesis and is false.
conventions.note: This is the primary 'junk-value' or edge convention: outside the set A the predicate imposes no constraint.

facts.statement: ∀ (X Y : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] (P : (x : X) → (nhds x).Germ Y → Prop) (A : Set X) (x : X) (f g : X → Y), VTask.RestrictGermPredicate P A x f → (∀ᶠ z in nhdsSet A, g z = f z) → VTask.RestrictGermPredicate P A x g

facts.statement: ∀ (X Y : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] (P : (x : X) → (nhds x).Germ Y → Prop) (A B : Set X) (x : X) (φ : (nhds x).Germ Y), A ⊆ B → VTask.RestrictGermPredicate P B x φ → VTask.RestrictGermPredicate P A x φ
